title: custody.confirmed body
description: Tells a task's holder that the team services recorded its custody, with its custody token and custody window, and, on a host whose certificate names its tools, the task's access list. The team services send it again with the same custody token to renew a window or to replace the access list. The frame carries the task's authority token when the work has one: the only way the holder of pool work receives it (README, "On behalf of a person", "Custody windows").

sequence.description: The team services number their confirmations and moves (custody.moved) for each task from 1, across custody tokens; the holder applies a confirmation only when its sequence is higher than the last confirmation or move it applied, so a confirmation delivered after its task moved is ignored.

reason.description: Why it was sent: a claim was recorded, the task was reassigned to this holder, a lapsed or ending window is renewed after the host reconnected, or the task's access list changed. Only claimed and reassigned carry the task's authority token, and never to an outside agent.

access_list.description: Present exactly when the holder's host certificate names its tools.
